content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. Here are the points I would like to discuss: - Regarding the termination terms, the client can terminate the agreement unilaterally with short notice, while your right to terminate is severely restricted, creating an unbalanced relationship. I propose that we change this so that either Party may terminate this Agreement upon providing thirty (30) days' written notice to the other Party. - Regarding the immediate termination clause, the client can terminate the contract immediately without notice based on broad or subjective conditions. I propose that we change this so that the Client may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if the Contractor is convicted of any felony or engages in willful misconduct materially affecting the Services. - Regarding the intellectual property clause, this clause treats all work as a work-for-hire and transfers ownership of your work to the Client immediately upon creation, before you are guaranteed to receive payment. I propose that we change this so that all proprietary materials prepared by the Contractor under this Agreement shall become the exclusive property of the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such materials. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
